title: Document Q&A assistant
oneLiner: Ask questions in natural language about uploaded PDFs and get answers with source citations.

shots.alt: Ask page with an offline cached answer, the cited span highlighted in the PDF pane, and the retrieval trace drawer open.
Eval page showing the committed report, gate values, denominators, and Wilson intervals.
Failure gallery: three cases where a naive answer would be wrong, with the passages and numbers behind each verdict.
Cross-encoder rerank section of the trace drawer: rerank rank, score, calibrated probability, and kept/dropped for each candidate.

invariants.claim: A chunk longer than 448 model tokens fails ingest instead of storing a truncated vector.
A claim without an in-context citation, or whose quote is not a normalised substring of the cited chunk, is dropped.
Ingest refuses a PDF whose SHA-256 differs from corpus.lock.json.
The refusal threshold comes from eval/calibration.json at boot and is never hand-tuned.
Every rate carries a Wilson 95% interval and its denominator; the earliest failed stage is recorded per question.
The judge model differs from the generator and is pinned by exact id.
ONNX work runs in a worker thread behind Semaphore(2).

limits: No generator model key on this machine: answers use the labelled extractive fallback, and the answer-rate gate fails at 5/24.
The eval set is 30 questions (24 answerable), not the planned 100; the Wilson intervals are correspondingly wide.
Judge reliability (Cohen's kappa) is unverified: eval/judge.yaml is pinned, but no judge endpoint or human anchor set exists.
Local only: no hosted URL, and the k6 concurrency scenario is unverified because k6 is not installed on this machine.
The corpus PDFs are not committed; this snapshot is reproducible only after scripts/fetch-corpus has materialised the locked files.
